entities.name: Mesh-ki-ang-gasher
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Meshkiangasher was a legendary king of the Sumerians, who ruled in the city of Uruk around 2800 BCE. As the priest of the Eanna temple, he played a significant role in the spiritual and political landscape of ancient Sumeria. His journey led him to the sea and the mountains, where he sought to understand the mysteries of the universe. This event, known as the 'Descent of Meshkiangasher,' has been passed down through the ages as a mythical tale of spiritual quest and self-discovery.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Meshkiangasher's journey to the sea and the mountains had a profound impact on the spiritual and cultural practices of the Sumerians, influencing the development of Sumerian mythology and the importance of priestly classes in ancient Mesopotamia.
